scenicChapters.title: Atlanterhavsvegen Norwegian Scenic Route
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 31 km this is Atlanterhavsvegen Norwegian Scenic Route, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.

sections.advice: Christchurch → Castle Hill is 102 km of getting across. Ride it tidily and keep the enthusiasm for what comes after.
Castle Hill → Arthurs Pass climbs about 920 m in 42 km. This is the part worth slowing down for - look through the bends and use the pull-offs.
Arthurs Pass → Otira Gorge drops about 920 m over 5 km. Brakes and eyes forward; the views are behind the corners, not in them.
Otira Gorge → Greymouth is 73 km of getting across. Ride it tidily and keep the enthusiasm for what comes after.

scenicChapters.title: Castle Hill → Arthurs Pass
scenicChapters.narrative: The ground tilts up and stays tilted for 75 km. 920 m of it, taken steadily rather than in one wall — a steady rhythm suits this better than bursts. The height arrives whether you hurry or not.

scenicChapters.title: Arthur Pass Highway
scenicChapters.narrative: 920 m come off over 9 km at around 17.8%. The road gives back what the climb took, faster than it took it. Brakes early, eyes far ahead. A descent this long asks more of concentration than of pace.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

arthur-pass-highway.story: 395 km from Christchurch to Greymouth, about 5 h 20 of riding. On the way it passes Castle Hill, Arthurs Pass and Otira Gorge. The highest point is about 1,150 m. It suits an unhurried touring pace.
